patch_description: Instead of returning zeros, this design uses a two-phase pipeline: (1) generate a deterministic structured seed configuration (boundary + interior lattice) inside the equilateral triangle, (2) run a fixed-seed simulated annealing optimizer whose objective is the normalized minimum triangle area over all 165 point triplets, computed vectorized with NumPy. The architecture is modularized into separate helper functions (area computation, boundary projection, annealing loop), improving maintainability while keeping the same zero-argument signature and (11,2) ndarray output.
